stem: A freshly adjusted solution measures pH 5.8, but after thorough mixing and a short stabilization period it reads 6.3. What should the technician do?
choices: Record only the first number because it was closer to target
Use the facility procedure for mixing/stabilization and verify the final representative reading before release
Keep adding acid without further measurement
Assume the meter is wrong because pH cannot change after mixing
rationale: A representative final measurement should follow the defined mixing and stabilization procedure. Early readings may not represent the final bulk solution.
